study.title: Casamena
study.subtitle: A brand, motion language and website for a private real estate practice that sells homes through introductions, not listings.
study.overview: The best homes in Lagos were never listed. They moved between people who knew each other, through introductions and conversations in the right rooms. Casamena was built to work the same way: an off-market practice for waterfront residences, penthouses and fractional investment. The brief was to give that quiet network a public face, a brand that signals access without ever shouting about it.

accordion.title: Challenge
accordion.body: Luxury property marketing in Lagos is loud: glossy listings, price tags, crowded portals. Casamena needed a public face for a private network, one that signals access without shouting about it.

accordion.title: Strategy
accordion.body: Private access. Perfectly handled. A network, not a database, with restraint as the luxury signal. Three steps carry it: Introduction, Selection, Handled. Voice: "We keep the best ones quiet."

accordion.title: The idea
accordion.body: Unlocking doors. The mark is a Lagos skyline drawn as one continuous line with a door at its centre. From it comes a family of doorway shapes that frame every property. Nothing is shown in full. You get a glimpse, the way an introduction works.

accordion.title: Outcome
accordion.body: An unreleased concept, 2026. 30+ brand touchpoints, 8 motion pieces and 1 website designed and built (8 homepage sections, desktop and mobile). A record of the design output rather than business results.

blocks.alt: The best homes in Lagos were never listed
blocks.caption: THE BEST HOMES IN LAGOS WERE NEVER LISTED.

blocks.heading: PRIVATE ACCESS. PERFECTLY HANDLED.
blocks.body:
Luxury property marketing in Lagos is loud: glossy listings, price tags, crowded portals. We positioned Casamena as the opposite. A network, not a database. Restraint as the luxury signal.

Introduction: we take time to understand a client's lifestyle, not just the specification. Selection: only what is right, drawn from a private network before any public listing. Handled: private viewing, negotiation and full transaction management. You handle the keys.

blocks.heading: EVERY FRAME IS A DOORWAY.
blocks.body: "Unlocking doors" became the organising idea. The mark is a Lagos skyline drawn as a single continuous line with a door at its centre. From it we cut a family of doorway shapes (gables, arches, keyholes) that act as windows into each property. Nothing is shown in full.

blocks.alt: Image opening through a doorway shape
blocks.caption: THE DOOR OPENS — EVERY IMAGE ENTERS THROUGH A DOORWAY.

blocks.heading: A SKYLINE WITH A DOOR IN IT.
blocks.body: The symbol traces Lagos' waterfront towers in one unbroken line, with a doorway at the centre. In gold it reads as a key. The wordmark is set in a calm, open grotesk so the symbol carries the character.

blocks.caption: LOGO STING — THE LINE DRAWS THE SKYLINE.

blocks.heading: LAGOS AT DUSK, AFTER THE LIGHTS COME ON.
blocks.body: Maroon is the dominant field, like the doors and wood of old Lagos homes. Sunset orange is the voice, used for headlines. Gold is reserved for the symbol, like a key. Zodiak sets headlines large and calm; Archivo carries body, navigation and data.

blocks.caption: COLOUR — MAROON, SUNSET, LINEN, INK, KEY GOLD.

blocks.heading: ONE LINE, MANY THRESHOLDS.
blocks.body: Three tools run the system: the skyline line (pattern), the doorway shapes (image frames) and a strict hairline grid borrowed from architectural drawings. Together they let a single designer build on-brand layouts in minutes.

blocks.caption: DOORWAYS — SIX APERTURES THAT FRAME PHOTOGRAPHY.
THE LINE DRAWS — LEFT TO RIGHT, LIKE A SIGNATURE.
PATTERN — THE SKYLINE, CROPPED AT ANY SCALE.

blocks.heading: NOTHING RUSHES. EVERYTHING OPENS.
blocks.body:
Motion follows the brand's manners: slow to start, decisive in the middle, soft to land. Images enter through a doorway that grows from a hairline outline into a full photograph. The skyline draws as a single stroke. Headlines rise 24px and fade in line by line, staggered 80ms.

Easing cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1) · 600 / 900 / 1200 ms · stagger 80 ms.

blocks.heading: A FEED THAT READS LIKE A PRIVATE CATALOGUE.
blocks.body: Three post types (statement, listing and story) run on the same hairline grid. Copy does the selling, and photography is only ever glimpsed through a doorway or a grid cell.

blocks.heading: "SOME HOMES WERE NEVER LISTED."
blocks.body: The launch campaign turns discretion into intrigue. Out-of-home placements show almost nothing: a doorway, a line, a URL. Print and digital carry the second message: fractional access to investment-grade property.

blocks.heading: A WEBSITE THAT BEHAVES LIKE A PRIVATE VIEWING.
blocks.body: livecasamena.com is designed to slow visitors down. No search bar, no price filters, no listing grid. Each property is a short story told through doorway-framed imagery, and every call to action leads to a person, not a form. The mobile site is the primary experience: one thumb, one door at a time, and a sticky "Enquire privately" button.

blocks.caption: MOBILE — ONE THUMB, ONE DOOR AT A TIME.

blocks.heading: FROM STRATEGY TO CODE, BUILT END TO END.
blocks.body: An unreleased concept, 2026. 30+ brand touchpoints, 8 motion pieces and 1 website designed and built.
